title: wt refs sweep --dry-run --json
description: What `wt refs sweep` would move: every branch and tag, here and with --remote on origin, whose name matches a backup pattern, and what it is. Printed by `wt refs sweep --json` without --yes as the only thing on stdout; it moves nothing. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

patterns.description: ref_sweep_patterns, in the order they are tried.

now.description: Unix seconds the plan was made at; age is measured from it.

url.description: origin's one effective URL, fetch and push alike, insteadOf and pushInsteadOf applied, with all userinfo removed (git@host:o/r is host:o/r).

digest.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the effective URL's UTF-8 bytes.

endpoint.description: With --remote: the one URL all contact with origin goes through, and its digest, which the token covers. Null without --remote.

runId.description: Always null: the run that applies the plan mints it.

token.description: Names the plan: pass it to --yes --expect. Null when no row could be swept, or on error. --only does not change it.

code.description: remoteAmbiguous: --remote, and origin's effective fetch and push URLs are not one and the same URL. remoteCredentialsInUrl: --remote, and that URL carries a password (in any form, scp-like too), or any userinfo on http, https, ftp or ftps; a <transport>::<address> URL is judged on its address too. planChanged: the plan is not the one --expect named, or not the one the question was asked about. runIdTaken: --run-id names a run that has refs under refs/wt-swept/ already.

problems.description: Codes for why no plan could be made; empty otherwise.

id.description: refs/heads/<name> or refs/tags/<name> here; origin:refs/heads/<name> or origin:refs/tags/<name> on origin. --only takes it, one id per flag and never split: a ref name may contain a comma.

name.description: The short name the pattern matched.

category.description: backupContained: another ref contains it (selected). backupOld: it holds commits no other ref has and is older than age (selected). backupYoung: the same, younger (not selected unless --only names it). kept: something holds it; kept says what.

selected.description: A sweep with this plan moves it: backupContained and backupOld by default, or what --only names.

tip.description: The commit; null when it is not here (objectMissing).

object.description: The ref's own value: the tag object of an annotated tag, else the tip.

annotated.description: Tags: an annotated tag. Null for branches.

containedIn.description: The first ref that contains the tip: trunk, then origin's branches, then the rest. A remote row names origin's ref as origin:<ref>.

uniqueCommits.description: Commits on no container; null when contained or not known.

date.description: Unix seconds: when the branch was created, the tag was made, or the tip was committed; see dateSource.

kept.description: Every reason that holds it; empty unless category is kept.
